shadows.name: none-flat

motion.purpose: Crisp two-frame state snaps for modal openings and row state changes.

components.name: Filter Tab (Active)
components.description: Selected queue filter pill in the 220px left graphite rail.
components.css: .ds-filter-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 196px; padding: 6px 10px; background: #22201d; color: #eae6df; border: 1px solid #d97724; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-tab .ds-count { font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Primary action trigger for Paste & Probe, Download Now, and Restart Fresh.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #eae6df; border: 1px solid #2563eb; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; }

components.name: URL Dispatch Input
components.description: Monospaced HTTP/HTTPS URL input field in the 56px top toolbar.
components.css: .ds-url-input { width: 100%; background: #f2efe9; color: #141413; border: 1px solid #dfdbd2; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 12px; font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; outline: none; } .ds-url-input:focus-visible { border-color: #2563eb; }

components.name: Validator Badge
components.description: Stamped HTTP capability or validator badge in the bottom inspector.
components.css: .ds-validator-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; background: #2563eb; color: #eae6df; border: 1px solid #2c2a27; border-radius: 3px; font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Graduated Interval Byte-Map Ruler
components.description: Signature proportional [0..total_bytes) bar showing disk Checkpoints vs in-flight Segment chunks.
components.css: .ds-ruler { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 18px; background: #22201d; border: 1px solid #2c2a27; } .ds-seg { display: flex; flex: 1; height: 100%; } .ds-seg + .ds-seg { border-left: 1px solid #181715; } .ds-cp { background: #2563eb; height: 100%; } .ds-fly { background: #d97724; height: 100%; }

narrative.overview: Posthaze Download Manager pairs a warm graphite emulsion shell (#181715) with a high-legibility silver-halide paper work surface (#F2EFE9) so power users can scan dozens of concurrent HTTP/HTTPS Downloads without visual fatigue while reading exact byte-range Checkpoint telemetry at a glance.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-ground contrast separating dark graphite instrument rails from warm silver-halide table paper.
Two-tier transfer honesty distinguishing writer-acknowledged disk Checkpoints (Cyanotype Blue) from in-flight Chunks (Selenium Amber).
Tabular monospaced telemetry (Consolas) paired with Windows system UI sans (Segoe UI).
Hairline 1px borders with flat elevation and crisp 90ms two-frame state snaps.

rules.name: The Dual-Ground Truth Rule
rules.body: Never paint active telemetry colors onto decorative backgrounds; Selenium Amber (#D97724) and Cyanotype Blue (#2563EB) exclusively signify live bytes in flight versus flushed bytes on disk.

rules.name: The Light-on-Dark Compensation Rule
rules.body: Text rendered on #181715 graphite surfaces steps up line height (18px for 12px body, 16px for 11px micro) so silver ink stays legible without glare.

rules.name: The Hairline Partition Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from ground contrast (#181715 vs #F2EFE9) and 1px structural rules—never soft shadows or glowing halos.

dos: Do compute all Segment ratios and formatting in pure Rust (crates/posthaze-ui/src/view_model.rs) with unit tests.
Do keep crates/posthaze-ui strictly decoupled from HTTP, SQLite, and .part files via EngineBridge.
Do surface EngineError::ResourceChanged inline with Restart Fresh and Delete actions.
donts: Don't round the ends of the Graduated Interval Byte-Map Ruler or progress bars (0px radius keeps byte ratios exact).
Don't block GPUI's render thread with DownloadEngine calls; dispatch via EngineBridge on the background Tokio runtime.
Don't invent placeholder data or skip probe() before starting a URL from the UI.
